Create an annotated UI DESIGN REVIEW BOARD for Ryn, a peer-to-peer device and services application. Match attached latest UI for typography, colors, layout craft and icons; this is continuation, NOT new visual direction. Board target 3200 x 1500, super high resolution crisp Chinese text. Exactly TWO equally sized complete desktop app frames SIDE BY SIDE, LEFT LIGHT THEME, RIGHT DARK THEME, same page and same UI state. User explicitly requested both themes; these are companion states not alternatives. Frames wide enough for readable text. Outside frames, slim board title at top and a clean four-item numbered annotation legend at bottom. Tiny numbered callout circles 1 2 3 4 next to relevant UI controls within each app, visually distinct muted amber, do not cover text. No sprawling arrows across UI. Legends OUTSIDE app chrome. Board canvas neutral #ECEEF1. Top theme labels 浅色 / 深色. Footer 概念设计 · 示例数据 · 尚未接入真实服务. No actual source screenshots claim.

Product constraints: first stage PERSONAL-centric but node network and providing services to others REMAIN CORE. Same left navigation in EVERY page: Ryn brand and Lay 的空间 picker, 我的空间, 服务, 节点, 任务; lower 更多 with 内容探索 and 聊天; 设置 bottom. Current page selected. Default Chinese. Personal use no payment/balances/credits. Same restrained bluegrey and sage palette, no bright saturation, ecommerce hero, product photography, large illustration, KPIs or fake graphs. Light porcelain/slate blue; dark graphite/muted bluegray. Body readable 14-16px equivalents, headings24px, small exquisite controls, fine border, calm spacing. Desktop computers ALL SAME monitor-only icon: narrow rounded screen with simple abstract blue wave, short silver stem and base, NO tower case. Notebook icon MUST be a slim open notebook with simple screen and minimal base, no detailed keys or physical product photo. Use laptop icon wherever local laptop appears, monitor for home/office. Service icons: lilac sparkle in softly rounded square for AI, quiet sage sheet for documents, muted blue connected points for nodes. NEVER metal AI pinwheel. No real hardware renders, no RGB. Distinct name and optional private note on each node. Name/notes concise real Chinese, not placeholder lorem ipsum. Status clear offline items can't be used. No model/hardware performance guarantees. Current date2026-09-21; avoid dates except coherent task examples if needed. Page-specific spec follows:
BOARD TITLE: 01 我的空间 / 默认首页. Home screen refined from reference. Top title 我的空间, subtitle 先用好自己的设备，再连接更多节点. Compact top-right 添加设备 with callout1.
Three device tiles across top: 家里台式机 (monitor) 在线 / RTX5090 · 2项服务 / note 书房主机，晚间可用; 随身笔记本 (LAPTOP!) 本机 / note 出差随身使用; 公司电脑 (SAME monitor as home) 离线 / note 工作日使用. Home selected, tile includes tiny edit pencil near its name callout2. Device note on separate small muted line, no overly dense content.
Below left area 可用服务 with 私人AI / 家里台式机 / 使用 button callout3; 文档转换 / 家里台式机 / 打开. Below a quiet row 其他节点的服务 → 浏览服务. Right selected-device compact panel 家里台式机, 本机 laptop connected to 家里 monitor small icons, 状态 已连接, 可用范围 仅自己的设备, outline 分享服务 button callout4. No duplicate giant feature cards.
ANNOTATION LEGEND exact:
1 添加设备：进入配对流程
2 名称与备注：每个节点均可编辑
3 使用服务：进入对应服务页面
4 分享服务：授权给指定节点
Show same details both themes, preserve laptop vs monitor distinction.

Heading 节点, subtitle 管理连接关系与访问权限. Top-right 添加节点 callout1. Tabs 我的设备 / 其他节点; choose 其他节点. A simple master list left with two rows: 阿哲的电脑 (monitor icon) 在线 / 对方名称：Azhe-PC / 私人备注：朋友的语音服务; 工作室 (monitor icon) 离线 / 对方名称：Studio-01 / 私人备注：视频处理. First selected.
Right inspector 阿哲的电脑, 在线; small subline 对方名称 Azhe-PC, short stable 节点ID 8b2f…c914 as optional detail, not user input. Fields 本地别名 阿哲的电脑 and 私人备注 朋友的语音服务 with 编辑 button callout2. A compact info line 别名和备注仅自己可见，不修改对方名称.
